episodes.synopsis: The selfish crown princess changes for the better, her newfound precognition deemed the cause. Yet her father and the others don’t know the truth: she had been reincarnated.
episodes.title: The Selfish Princess Awakens

episodes.synopsis: Someday Stale will avenge his mother. He will get it done no matter what. If only he could remember the dream he had, would that help?
episodes.title: The Villainous Princess Makes a Request of Her Brother

episodes.synopsis: When a military exercise goes wrong, Pride must spare no effort to ensure everyone returns alive.
episodes.title: The Heretical Princess and the Knights

episodes.synopsis: In another life, Pride's callousness resulted in tragedy and a powerful enemy. But in this life, her compassion saved those fated to die and earned her an unexpected ally.
episodes.title: The Worst Princess and the Young Man's Vow

episodes.synopsis: Arthur abandoned his dream to be a knight due to his embarrassing special ability. Inspired by Pride’s actions, he embraces his ambition once again.
episodes.title: The Wicked Princess and the Sword

episodes.synopsis: Heavy is the head that wears the crown. Pride must prove her mettle as the future queen by passing judgment on an enemy, but she worries this will set her on the road to ruin.
episodes.title: The Selfish Princess Passes Judgment

episodes.synopsis: What would drive someone to desperation? The answer is as simple as it is old as time: love.
episodes.title: The Coldhearted Princess and the Quitter

episodes.synopsis: Arthur’s power to grow crops is absolutely worthless for a knight. Or is it? Pride’s actions are about to change multiple lives forever.
episodes.title: The Insolent Princess and the Judgment

episodes.synopsis: Pride once told a criminal to seek her out if he was ever faced with an impossible situation. That day has finally come.
episodes.title: The Cruel Princess and the Criminal

episodes.synopsis: Pride and her friends hatch a daring plan to rescue the kidnapped children.
episodes.title: The Coldhearted Princess Sneaks In

episodes.synopsis: Val won’t leave anyone behind, even at the cost of his life. This time, Pride’s precognition cannot help her; this crisis has never happened before.
episodes.title: The Merciless Princess and the Order

episodes.synopsis: Pride has changed many lives for the better, but is it truly enough to escape her destiny? She doesn’t believe so. Regardless, that won’t stop her from helping others.
episodes.title: The Treacherous Princess Faces the Future
